scope: Private S31 Winbond-profile Sector Erase and USER Page Program,actual Flash mutation and optional successful-PC-retirement observation. No shared production runtime/UI change.
sources: Existing sources.json fixed S31 ROM20260528,IDF6.1 fff9895 SPI1 register/IO_MUX headers and Winbond-authored W25Q128JV RevF2018 sections7.1.2/8.2.13/8.2.15. PDFs are public distributor-mirror copies with exact URL/time/hash in the prior source manifest. No new unversioned hardware values.

semantics.writeEnable: Missing WEL leaves array unchanged; successful accepted erase/program clears WEL. Unsupported profiles and malformed operations fault before mutation.
semantics.erase: 4KiB sector selected by24-bit address with low12ignored; entire supplied backing sector must exist. Only ef4018 unprotected profile.
semantics.program: USER opcode02,command8/address24,MOSI byte-aligned1..64 bytes. Within256-byte page addresses wrap,only transmitted bytes are ANDed; cannot turn0 into1. Validate all addressed backing bytes before mutation.
semantics.timing: Functional synchronous completion after real array change,no BUSY latency/wear/reset interruption.
semantics.cache: Private functional cache has no retained lines; mapped data/fetch observe the same backing array. No production JIT cache/invalidation changes.
semantics.observer: Optional single caller address; counts only successful instruction retirement,records pre-instruction cycle count. Does not redirect PC or affect guest bytes.
semantics.notImplemented: Other direct PP/block/chip erase,protection/security,status writes,suspend,power-failure semantics,product persistence or board/display readiness.
